beginner.summary: For developers who know another language such as Java, Python, C# or JavaScript and are new to Kotlin. Covers the JDK, Gradle and IntelliJ IDEA toolchain, values and types, control flow, functions, null safety, strings, classes, inheritance, data, enum and sealed classes, objects, collections, lambdas, collection pipelines, scope and extension functions, exceptions and Result, generics, file handling, testing with kotlin.test and Gradle Kotlin DSL builds, finishing with a command-line task tracker.
prerequisites: Writes working programs in at least one other language with variables, loops, functions and classes
Uses a terminal confidently to run commands and set environment variables
Has a laptop with rights to install a JDK 21 or later and IntelliJ IDEA
outcomes: Install the Kotlin toolchain and build, run and test projects with Gradle
Write idiomatic Kotlin using null safety, data classes, sealed types, collections and lambdas
Handle errors with exceptions and Result and read and write files safely
Build, test and package a command-line application
